{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is positive (1.00), pull forecasts toward mean-reversion by 10-15% to correct lag",
    "When sentiment is negative (0.00 or 0.33), push forecasts 3-5 basis points below current to capture downward momentum",
    "Adjust mid-range sentiment (0.67) forecasts toward the 5-day price average to reduce noise",
    "Apply 2-3 basis point daily deceleration to forecasts when price change velocity is accelerating",
    "Scale correction magnitude by inverse R² from 7-day price regression to match forecast confidence",
    "When true outcomes show mean reversion to 18-day mean, shift corresponding forecast segments toward that mean by 0.3-0.5 points",
    "Increase forecast-price deviation for segments more than 2 standard deviations from forecast mean to reduce overconfidence"
] }
